title: Xbox Server Status: Outage Impacts Thousands
description: Xbox server status is a trending topic in Canada as thousands of users report issues with Xbox services, leading to a surge in searches for 'xbox server status'.

sections.heading: Xbox Server Outage
paragraphs: Reports of Xbox server issues have surged, with thousands of users affected by the outage, according to Hindustan Times. The error code '0x87e107df' has been commonly reported by users, indicating a problem with the Xbox Live service.

sections.heading: Microsoft 365 Outage
paragraphs: BleepingComputer reports that a massive Microsoft 365 outage was blamed on a maintenance bug by Microsoft. This could potentially be related to the Xbox server issues, as both services are under the Microsoft umbrella.

sections.heading: Azure Data Center Incident
paragraphs: TheStack.technology reports that a network maintenance error separated an Azure West data center from the internet for hours. This incident might have contributed to the Xbox server status issues, as Azure is a cloud computing service used by Microsoft.

faq.q: What is the current status of Xbox servers?
faq.a: As of the latest reports, Xbox servers are experiencing an outage affecting thousands of users.

faq.q: What error code is commonly reported with the Xbox server issues?
faq.a: The error code '0x87e107df' is being frequently reported by users facing issues with Xbox services.

faq.q: Is the Xbox server outage related to a Microsoft 365 outage?
faq.a: While not confirmed, the timing of a massive Microsoft 365 outage, blamed on a maintenance bug, coincides with the Xbox server issues.

faq.q: How might an Azure data center incident be related to Xbox server status?
faq.a: An incident that separated an Azure West data center from the internet for hours could potentially impact Xbox services, as Azure provides cloud computing services for Microsoft.
